excerpt.zh: 大前天晚上，首席考古学家[From.Leader.GetName]报告说看到了令人不安的景象，并且一直被关在自己的房间里直到现在。他们认为是我们这里的某种东西引发的……
excerpt.en: Three nights ago, chief archaeologist [From.Leader.GetName] reported having a disturbing vision and has been shut away in their quarters until now. They believed the source to be whatever is down here with us...
